questions.passage:
Independent workshops offered training in different parts of the city. A local corporation paid for a shared booking service, but the workshops still ran their own classes. One employee coordinated the timetables so learners could attend more than one workshop. Instructors also agreed to cooperate on a course booklet.

When the booklet was tested, some readers asked for more drawings. The instructors incorporated their suggestions into the next edition by adding pictures that showed how to adjust equipment. The sponsor wanted its logo on the cover, but the instructors preferred to leave corporate advertising out of the booklet.
questions.q: The word “incorporated” in Paragraph 2 most nearly means that the instructors
o: sent the suggestions to the corporate sponsor.
asked the workshops to agree on the suggestions.
included the suggestions in the revised booklet.
arranged meetings to discuss the suggestions.
questions.answer_support: incorporated their suggestions into the next edition by adding pictures
questions.target: incorporate into 与合作、协调和公司词族
questions.skill: incorporate into 与合作、协调和公司词族

exp.trans: 独立培训工坊共享预约系统，有人统筹课程表，教师合作编手册。随后教师按学员建议在新版中加入设备图，没有把公司广告加进手册。
exp.structure: 第一段区分赞助者、统筹人员和共同编写者。第二段的句型是 incorporate 建议 into 新一版，by adding 进一步说明如何落实。
exp.other: corporation 是公司，corporate 是形容词。cooperate with 或 on 表合作，名词 cooperation。coordinate timetables 是协调时间，名词 coordination。
exp.meaning: 建议经过落实，成为新版小册子的一部分。这符合把某物纳入整体的含义。
exp.rest: 赞助商负责预约系统并谈到标志。协调时间表及合作编写是另外的行动。原文也没有安排会议或把建议送给赞助方。

questions.target: 过去分词后置修饰与动作主体
questions.skill: 区分拟写、支持与推翻决定
questions.passage: A festival director rejected a plan for a film screening after receiving a high estimate for hiring equipment. The projectionist challenged the estimate in a report endorsed by two technicians familiar with the site. The report set out a cheaper way to use the festival's own equipment. It suggested moving the audience closer to a smaller screen, which the existing projector could light evenly after dusk. The committee considered the report at its next meeting and overruled the director's decision. The screening went ahead in a courtyard with room for a smaller audience.
questions.q: Which account accurately describes the decision and the technicians' role?
o: The technicians backed the report, and the committee reversed the refusal.
The technicians wrote the report, and the director reversed his own decision.
The director backed the report, and the technicians approved the screening.
The technicians backed the report, but the committee upheld the refusal.
questions.answer_support: in a report endorsed by two technicians familiar with the site. The report set out a cheaper way to use the festival's own equipment. It suggested moving the audience closer to a smaller screen, which the existing projector could light evenly after dusk. The committee considered the report at its next meeting and overruled the director's decision.

exp.trans: 节庆总监看到设备租赁报价太高，拒绝了放映计划。放映员在一份得到两名技术人员支持的报告里质疑报价，建议把观众安排得更靠近小屏幕，这样现有投影机在黄昏后就够用。委员会审阅报告并推翻了总监的决定，放映最终在一个可容纳少量观众的庭院举行。
exp.structure: 主干是 The projectionist challenged the estimate。in a report 交代载体，endorsed by two technicians 是修饰 report 的过去分词短语，可还原为 which was endorsed by two technicians。另一句由 the committee 作主语，执行 overruled 的动作。
exp.other: projectionist（放映员）、estimate（报价、估价）、endorse（支持、认可）、go ahead（按计划进行）。
exp.meaning: 技术人员对报告表示支持。委员会推翻了总监的决定，因此放映得以举行。类似 an opinion joined by four other justices 中的 joined by，分词给出支持意见的人。
exp.rest: 质疑报价由放映员在报告中提出，无法从技术人员签署支持推出他们执笔。撤销原决定的是委员会。upheld 表示维持，文中的 overruled 表示推翻。

questions.q: Students taking optional coding classes scored higher, but they also started with stronger skills. After comparisons among students with equal initial ability, the score gap disappeared. What follows?
o: The classes must have lowered every student's final score.
Initial skill can be ignored when comparing the groups.
Prior ability may account for the observed association.
All students received identical training outside class.

exp.trans: 选修编程课学生成绩更好，但入学技能也更强；在相同起始技能者之间比较后差距消失。
exp.structure: but提示潜在混杂变量；after comparisons揭示调整后关联消失。
exp.other: confounding混杂；association关联；initial ability起始能力。
exp.meaning: 起始技能可能解释原本观察到的关联，不能直接把关联等同课程的因果效果。
exp.rest: 成绩全部下降、起始能力可忽略和接受相同课外训练都没有依据。

questions.passage:
An online marketplace told customers they would see the full price before placing an order. Yet the first week of a trial showed that delivery companies could add their own fees once they took charge of an order. Some customers accepted the delivery charge because it was small.

When the marketplace introduced yet another fee for evening orders, even some of those same customers complained. To them, the total amount on the screen mattered more than which company was charging each part of it.
questions.q: The phrase “yet another fee” in Paragraph 2 refers to
o: a charge replacing the earlier delivery fee.
a charge that had been announced but not added.
a charge collected by a new delivery company.
a further charge on top of an existing one.
questions.answer_support: introduced yet another fee for evening orders
questions.target: 句首 Yet 和 yet another 的两种作用
questions.skill: 句首 Yet 和 yet another 的两种作用

exp.trans: 平台称下单前可见总价，后来却出现配送费。再添晚间订单费后，有些原本能接受配送费的顾客也不满。
exp.structure: 第一段句首 Yet 把平台承诺与试行结果连成转折。第二段 yet 修饰 another，强调重复增加。在引入晚间收费之前已经有一项费用。
exp.other: take charge of 接手，delivery charge 配送费，another 另一个。not yet 意为尚未。
exp.meaning: 新晚间费加在原有配送费之上，表示又多了一项。
exp.rest: introduced 表示费用已推出。原文没有说新费替代旧费，也没有把新费说成新的配送公司所收。

questions.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

questions.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
questions.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
questions.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It measures a shift in members' views on conservation.
It shows why government funds were needed for the trial.
It explains how the new system reduced water consumption.
It illustrates how local groups can help launch a policy.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 没有成员前后态度的测量，不能证明观点转变；材料没有交代政府资金；也没有比较节水系统的技术效果。合作社组织志愿者和动员试用，支持的是政策启动机制。

questions.passage:
When a town announced that its old library might close, campaigners demanded that the building be saved at all costs. Their anger was understandable. Generations had studied there, and a public building carries memories that cannot be priced like office space. But the phrase concealed a difficult question: what other services would have to be reduced to pay for it?

A smaller library in a shared building would lose something valuable. It could nevertheless preserve the service while releasing money for home visits to elderly readers. Recognising that possibility does not mean treating history as worthless. It means accepting that a worthy cause still has to be considered alongside other public needs.
questions.q: The author suggests that the town should
o: preserve the building whatever other services suffer.
judge the library mainly by the value of its site.
delay any decision until its historical value is priced.
weigh preservation against its other public duties.
questions.target: 识别at all costs的强度，避免把支持某目标读成不计代价
questions.skill: 识别at all costs的强度，避免把支持某目标读成不计代价
questions.answer_support: a worthy cause still has to be considered alongside other public needs

exp.trans: 作者理解居民保护老图书馆的愿望，但指出无论代价地保存建筑会挤占其他服务；替代方案可兼顾借阅与上门服务。
exp.structure: 先承认保护历史的价值，再追问代价，最后说明考虑其他需求并不等于否定历史。
exp.other: at all costs：不惜一切代价；alongside：与……一并考虑；worthy：值得支持的。
exp.meaning: 作者支持把保存建筑与其他公共职责一起衡量。这里要读出at all costs的强度，不能把它只当成努力程度高。
exp.rest: 不顾其他服务的损失延续了作者正在质疑的绝对立场；按地价评价建筑是作者反对的简化；原文没有要求先给历史标价。

questions.passage:
When she began cataloguing a collection of hand-drawn coastal maps, the archivist Lena Duarte assumed that every blank marked a stretch of coast that the surveyor, Ada Bell, had been unable to reach. A work diary showed otherwise. Bell had left those areas blank deliberately when the depth readings were too uncertain to publish.

Duarte now keeps the blanks in the digital edition. Filling them with data from newer surveys would make the maps more useful to sailors, but it would hide the limits of what Bell knew at the time. The edition is meant to show how surveyors worked, and those limits are part of the record.
questions.q: What did Duarte initially take the blanks to mean?
o: The surveyor had decided to withhold uncertain readings.
The surveyor could not reach those parts of the coast.
Some measurements had gone missing from the archive.
The maps were meant to be updated after later surveys.
questions.target: 同句前指与两个人物的判断归属
questions.skill: 同句前指与两个人物的判断归属
questions.answer_support: marked a stretch of coast that the surveyor, Ada Bell, had been unable to reach

exp.trans: 档案员杜阿尔特最初以为地图上的空白代表测绘员贝尔到不了那些海岸。日记说明贝尔测得了数据，只是数据太不确定，她有意留白。数字版保留空白来呈现当时知识的局限。
exp.structure: 第一句 When she began ... 的 she 指后面的 Lena Duarte。主句 Duarte assumed ... 交代档案员最初的解释，that从句中的 Ada Bell 是原测绘员。第二段交代档案员看过日记后的决策。
exp.other: catalogue 编目、登记，depth reading 水深读数，withhold 暂不公布。
exp.meaning: initially 限定档案员最初的判断。她当时以为贝尔无法到达空白所对应的海岸。
exp.rest: 故意不发布不确定读数是日记揭示的原因。原文未提及读数遗失。用后来的数据补图只是第二段提出的一种可能做法。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: Healthier seedlings prompted the gardeners to provide shade.
The gardeners' shade reduced heat exposure for the seedlings.
The seedlings sheltered the gardeners from the hottest sun.
The drying seedlings caused a fall in the surrounding heat.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: 把幼苗更健康当成遮阳的先前原因是因果倒置；幼苗保护园丁交换了施事与受益者；干枯导致环境降温既反转因果，又偷换了暴露量与环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension caused firms to miss the earlier deadline.
Measured gains in later participation prompted the council's extension.
Missed deadlines prompted an extension; later effects are unmeasured.
The earlier deadline was a response to the council's later extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: 后来的延期不能造成更早的错过期限；尚未测量的后续参与数据不能成为先前延期的依据；较早的规则也不是对较晚措施的回应。

causal-role-direction.target: causal direction / known vs unknown outcome
causal-role-direction.skill: 区分已知原因、措施与尚未验证的后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: A grant committee extended an application deadline after several applicants missed it. The report says the effect on later participation has not been measured. Which summary is justified?
o: The missed deadline prompted an extension; later participation effects remain unmeasured.
Later participation figures prompted the committee to extend the earlier deadline.
The extension caused applicants to miss a deadline that had already passed.
Officials changed the deadline only after a separate review showed participation had fallen.

exp.trans: 几名申请者错过截止日期后，拨款委员会延长了申请期限。报告说，尚未测量这一调整对后续参与情况的影响。最准确的概括是：错过截止日期促成了延期，但延期对后续参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: extended是主句谓语；after several applicants missed it交代延期的时间背景和触发情境；the effect...has not been measured明确限制了对后续结果的推断。
exp.other: grant committee 拨款委员会；application deadline 申请截止日期；participation 参与；measure 测量、评估。
exp.meaning: 必须区分已知的原因与尚未测量的后果。原文支持错过期限后发生延期，但不支持断言延期一定提高或降低后续参与。
exp.rest: 后续参与数据没有促成前面的延期；延期不可能导致申请者错过一个已经过去的截止日期；原文没有提到另一次审查或参与人数下降。

causal-role-direction.target: 措施与结果的对应关系
causal-role-direction.skill: 措施与结果的对应关系
causal-role-direction.q: By accepting a single signed form, the club allows volunteers to avoid requesting a separate signature for every shift. Which benefit is described?
o: Volunteers may work extra shifts without signing any form.
Volunteers need not seek another signature for each shift.
Supervisors supply more signatures for every new volunteer.
Only supervisors may change the shifts a volunteer accepts.

exp.trans: 俱乐部接受一份签好字的表格，从而使志愿者不必每个班次都另外请求签字。好处是省去反复请求签字的手续。
exp.structure: By accepting...说明俱乐部采取的措施；allows的宾语是volunteers；to avoid requesting...说明志愿者由此免于什么行为。separate signature是被省去的逐班次手续。
exp.other: shift 班次；signature 签字；avoid doing 避免做、不必做；single 单份的。
exp.meaning: 使某人免于寻找或请求某物，不等于给他更多该物。先列措施、受益主体、被省去的行为和结果，再检查选项有没有改成增加数量或扩大资格。
exp.rest: 原文仍有一份已签字表格，不能说完全无须签字或允许多工作班次；也未说主管供应更多签字；变更班次的权限没有提及。

causal-role-direction.q: After exercise classes began, staff took fewer sick days. Researchers wondered whether a simultaneous change in leave policy explained the drop, so they compared units where the policy had not changed. Why?
o: To prove that classes alone caused the drop.
To measure how much the staff enjoyed exercise.
To show that every unit changed its leave policy.
To test a rival explanation for the sick-day decline.

exp.trans: 健身课后员工病假减少，研究者怀疑同期请假制度变化也可能造成下降，于是检查制度未改变的部门。
exp.structure: wondered whether提出备选解释；so引出检验该解释的方法。
exp.other: rival explanation竞争性解释；leave policy请假制度。
exp.meaning: 对照政策未变的单位是检验替代原因，不是自动确证健身课的因果效果。
exp.rest: 不能凭这一比较证明唯一原因，也不是测量满意度或证明各单位都改了政策。

causal-role-direction.skill: 排除性证据与因果边界
causal-role-direction.q: Bird counts rose after riverfront lights were dimmed. Some argued that fewer boats explained the increase, but traffic records showed no decline in boats. What does this evidence do?
o: It demonstrates that lighting was the only possible cause.
It weakens the alternative explanation based on boat traffic.
It establishes that birds were never affected by boat noise.
It shows that the original bird counts were fabricated.

exp.trans: 调暗河岸灯光后鸟类增加；有人认为是船只减少所致，但记录显示船只没有减少。
exp.structure: some argued提出竞争性解释；but引出相反证据。
exp.other: traffic record流量记录；alternative explanation替代解释。
exp.meaning: 船只未减少削弱了船只减少造成增长的解释，但不能单凭此证明灯光是唯一原因。
exp.rest: 不能据此排除所有其他因素、证明船噪从无影响，或判定统计造假。

parallel-governance.q: The redesign owes its success not to a faster motor but to a simpler control panel. Which reading keeps the shared relation intact?
o: The faster motor owes its success to the control panel.
Success is credited to the panel rather than to the motor.
The simpler panel was made possible by the redesign's earlier success.
The sentence credits the motor and the panel equally.

exp.trans: 这次重新设计的成功不是由于更快的电机，而是由于更简单的控制面板。两个to短语共同说明同一个成功应归因于什么。
exp.structure: The redesign是主语，owes是谓语，its success是宾语。not to a faster motor和but to a simpler control panel是同层并列的归因补足语，都受owes its success支配。
exp.other: redesign 重新设计；owe A to B 把A归因于B；motor 电机；control panel 控制面板。
exp.meaning: 共享的是owe success to...的归因结构，不是让后半句生成新主语或改变成功的所属对象。not...but...排除电机、强调面板。
exp.rest: The faster motor owes...把电机改成主语并换掉success所属对象；panel was made possible...把面板作为成功的结果，反转因果；equally忽略not对电机解释的排除。

parallel-governance.target: 共同动词支配 / 并列任务
parallel-governance.q: The inspector recommended replacing the worn belt and checking the tension before restarting the machine. Which reading preserves the recommendation?
o: The inspector reported that both jobs had already been completed.
Replacing the belt was expected to check the tension automatically.
The inspector recommended two tasks: belt replacement and a tension check.
The machine should be restarted before either task is attempted.

exp.trans: 检查员建议在重新启动机器之前更换磨损的皮带并检查张力。建议包含两项任务：更换皮带和检查张力，而不是报告它们已经完成。
exp.structure: The inspector是主语，recommended是谓语。replacing the worn belt与checking the tension是并列动名词短语，共同作recommended的补足内容；before restarting the machine给执行顺序。
exp.other: inspector 检查员；worn belt 磨损的皮带；tension 张力；restart 重新启动。
exp.meaning: and把两项动作放在同一层级，都受recommended支配。后一个动名词不是第一个动作自动产生的效果，也不是新的已完成事实。
exp.rest: had already been completed把建议改成过去已完成事实；check ... automatically把两项独立任务合成一项的自动效果；restarted before either task反转before给出的执行顺序。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: The bonus increased hazards along with reports of near-misses.
Official incident totals are more reliable than the survey.
Anonymity motivated workers more than the safety bonus did.
Reporting changes can raise counts without raising hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 调查显示危险发生频率未变，不能断言奖励增加危险；材料没有给两种数据排可靠性名次；匿名是调查方式，不能据此比较匿名与奖金的激励强度。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分记录数量变化与真实风险变化
example-claim-scope.q: After a factory introduced anonymous reporting, recorded safety events rose. Independent inspections found no increase in hazards. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The factory became more dangerous after anonymous reporting was introduced.
The rise in reports proves workers deliberately exaggerated safety incidents.
The higher event count may reflect reporting changes rather than more hazards.
Independent inspections confirmed that hazards increased throughout the factory.

exp.trans: 工厂引入匿名报告后，记录到的安全事件增加了，但独立检查没有发现危险因素增加。最有根据的结论是：记录数量的上升可能来自报告方式的变化，而非真实危险增加。
exp.structure: After引导时间背景；recorded safety events rose描述记录数；Independent inspections found no increase in hazards提供独立证据，限制了对真实风险的推断。
exp.other: anonymous reporting 匿名报告；recorded event 记录到的事件；independent inspection 独立检查；hazard 危险因素。
exp.meaning: 报告数量是观测到的数据，可能受报告机制影响；不能直接把记录数增加等同于真实危险增加。
exp.rest: 直接断言工厂更危险，与独立检查结果不符；把报告增加归因于故意夸大，原文没有动机证据；把检查结果说反了。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分报告数量变化与真实问题变化
example-claim-scope.q: A clinic switched to an online incident form, after which recorded reports rose. External audits found no increase in underlying faults. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The underlying fault rate rose because the clinic changed its form.
More recorded incidents may reflect easier reporting, not more faults.
External audits proved the old reporting system had been accurate.
The clinic changed the form after a separate review found fewer faults.

exp.trans: 诊所改用在线事件表单后，记录的报告增加了，但外部审计没有发现实际故障增加。记录数量的上升可能来自报告更容易，而不是故障变多。
exp.structure: A clinic switched...描述制度变化；after which引出其后的记录变化；External audits found...提供独立证据，限制对真实故障率的推断。
exp.other: incident form 事件报告表；recorded report 记录的报告；external audit 外部审计；underlying fault 实际故障。
exp.meaning: 观测到的报告数会受到报告渠道影响。记录数增加不能单独证明实际问题变多。
exp.rest: 表单变化本身不能证明故障率上升；审计没有证明旧系统完全准确；文中没有说改表单之前另一次审查发现故障减少。

costs-effort-intensity.passage:
After severe flooding, a council promised to spare no effort in protecting local homes. The promise was popular, but deciding what it meant proved harder. A concrete wall would protect the town centre while pushing water towards farms downstream. Restoring wetlands would take longer, although it could reduce the pressure on both areas.

Officials eventually proposed a mixture of smaller barriers and wetland restoration. Some residents called this a retreat from the original promise. That criticism confuses determination with a willingness to accept any consequence. A serious effort to protect one community must still take account of the people who live beyond its boundary.
costs-effort-intensity.q: In this passage, "spare no effort" is closest in meaning to
o: complete the work without consulting others.
make every effort to achieve the stated goal.
accept whatever damage the project may cause.
give the most expensive proposal preference.
costs-effort-intensity.target: spare no effort强调尽力，不自动等于接受任何后果
costs-effort-intensity.skill: spare no effort强调尽力，不自动等于接受任何后果
costs-effort-intensity.answer_support: That criticism confuses determination with a willingness to accept any consequence.

exp.trans: 市政承诺全力防洪，随后选择兼顾上下游的组合方案。作者认为顾及其他社区不等于没有尽力。
exp.structure: 先给出承诺，接着展示不同方案的利弊，再反驳“考虑后果就是退缩”的批评。
exp.other: determination：决心；downstream：下游；take account of：考虑。
exp.meaning: make every effort对应尽全力的承诺。文中明确区分这种努力和接受任何后果的态度。
exp.rest: 不咨询别人、偏好最贵方案都不是短语含义；接受项目造成的任何损害，恰好混淆了努力与不惜代价。

costs-effort-intensity.target: at all costs 在上下文中得到支持的强度
costs-effort-intensity.skill: 识别说话者对牺牲和条件的态度
costs-effort-intensity.passage: For years a port operator kept its handling rates below those of neighbouring ports. The strategy at first attracted new business. As costs rose, managers postponed repairs and cut staff rather than reconsider the prices. One manager later recalled that the company had become determined to protect its market share at all costs. By the time the board changed course, some equipment could no longer be used. In his account, the biggest mistake was refusing to reconsider the policy once its effects became clear.
costs-effort-intensity.q: By saying "at all costs", the manager suggests that the company
o: kept the policy even when it meant serious sacrifices.
priced its services mainly to bring in money for repairs.
made every effort within the limits of its maintenance budget.
planned to adjust rates if demand for its services weakened.
costs-effort-intensity.answer_support: managers postponed repairs and cut staff rather than reconsider the prices

exp.trans: 码头公司靠低费率吸引业务，随后运营成本上涨，管理层推迟维修、裁员来维持旧价格。一位经理事后认为，为了保住市场份额，公司连明显的损失也接受，直到部分设备无法使用才改弦更张。
exp.structure: 先交代策略的合理起点，再描述实际牺牲。at all costs 出现在经理的回顾里，随后给出设备损坏的后果。
exp.other: handling rates（装卸费率）、postpone（推迟）、market share（市场份额）、change course（转变方针）。
exp.meaning: 经理批评的是公司愿意承担很大损失来守住一个目标。spare no effort 侧重尽力，不能单靠这个短语推出其他代价也可以接受。
exp.rest: 公司推迟维修，费率也没以支付维修为首要目的。管理层不愿根据已出现的问题重新考虑策略，这与有限度的努力及及时调价都不一致。

paragraph-order-cataphora.passage:
Whatever their differences over how to divide the cost, orchard owners Rosa Méndez and Daniel Hart agreed that the village needed a way to share equipment. Méndez wanted each farm to make a fixed payment for access. Hart proposed charging by the hour, arguing that a small grower could otherwise pay as much as a neighbour with three times as much land.

The village adopted Hart's plan after a vote. That choice settled how the cost would be shared, but it left a question open. Who would get a machine when several orchards needed it on the same day? The answer required a booking rule of its own.
paragraph-order-cataphora.q: The word “their” in the opening sentence refers to
o: the growers waiting to borrow the machines.
the two growers who differed over payment.
the villagers who voted on the payment plan.
the neighbours with much larger orchards.
paragraph-order-cataphora.target: 句首 their 的同句前指
paragraph-order-cataphora.skill: 句首 their 的同句前指
paragraph-order-cataphora.answer_support: Whatever their differences over how to divide the cost, orchard owners Rosa Méndez and Daniel Hart

exp.trans: 两位果园主都认为村里需要共享设备，对分摊费用各有看法。村里投票采纳按时计费的提案，预约优先顺序仍待解决。
exp.structure: 先读主句 orchard owners Rosa Méndez and Daniel Hart agreed ...，确认这句话在说哪两个人。再回到句首 Whatever their differences ...，their 指后面出现的这两位果园主。第二段的 That choice 回指村里采纳 Hart 的按时计费方案。
exp.other: orchard 果园，fixed payment 固定缴费，by the hour 按小时，leave a question open 使问题悬而未决。
exp.meaning: their differences 是这两位果园主在如何分摊费用上的分歧。接下来分别介绍了 Méndez 的固定缴费建议和 Hart 的按时收费建议。
exp.rest: 借机器的农户是后面预约问题涉及的人，参与投票的村民在第二段才出现。大果园只出现在 Hart 用来说明费用问题的假设例子里。
